steps.text: Sign in to your Spotify account in a web browser.
steps.note: Some apps cannot cancel Premium. Use a browser.

steps.text: Open Account, then Manage your plan.

steps.note: Check the end date the service shows. Payments stop on the date you set.

steps.text: Check your email for a confirmation from Spotify.
steps.note: If you pay through a partner or a mobile carrier, cancel with them. If you pay through Apple, Google or a mobile carrier, cancel there. See the Apple App Store or Google Play guide.
